name: Carson Smith
summary: Dog groomer with more than two years of hands-on shop experience and a patient, detail-focused approach. Growing from bathing into grooming, with returning clients who request her by name and a commitment to continuing to learn.

experience.tenure: More than two years of shop experience
highlights: Progressed from primarily bathing dogs to taking on an increasing number of grooms.
Brush, comb and shape coats, with careful attention to faces, topknots, ears and legs.
Add finishing touches such as bows and styled topknots to complement each groom.
Build relationships with returning clients who specifically request her at the shop.

award.title: Best First Timer Award
award.description: Recognized for grooming Fabrice, a Bichon Frise. His owner, Michele Stoudt-Wright, also wrote Fabrice’s Big Grooming Day about his grooming adventures with Carson.

training: Has taken several grooming courses to build technique alongside ongoing, hands-on experience in the shop.
animalExperience: Has fostered many puppies and cares for her corgi, Beauregard. Riding horses since about age eight, with competition experience and awards in horse jumping.
